host.comment: The editor: vscode, cursor, windsurf, vscodium, or other.

remote.comment: Where the extension runs: none, ssh, wsl, container, codespaces, or other.

arch.comment: x64, arm64, arm, ia32, or other.

surjeetbanga.logline/installed.comment: Logline ran for the first time on this machine.

surjeetbanga.logline/updated.comment: Logline started at a new version; from is the previous version.

surjeetbanga.logline/active_day.comment: The first time in a day someone did something in Logline.

surjeetbanga.logline/milestone.comment: The first time someone did one of a few key things, and how long after installing.

name.comment: One of: first_capture, first_search, first_filtered_search, first_view_switch, first_connection, first_share, first_agent_call, first_doctor_action, first_log_breakpoint.

surjeetbanga.logline/command.comment: A Logline command was run; the command id only, never its arguments.

surjeetbanga.logline/capture_started.comment: A kind of capture started, once per kind per session.

kind.comment: One of: terminal, debug, task, file, compose, command, otlp, import, connection.

surjeetbanga.logline/view_opened.comment: A view of the Logs panel was opened, once per view per session.

view.comment: One of: logs, analysis, compare, traces, trace, metrics, aiCalls, aiCall, doctor, connection.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_added.comment: A connection was added; its type and how it signs in, never its name or host.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_searched.comment: A connection was searched; its type, outcome, time, and row count bucket.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_tailed.comment: A connection was tailed; its type.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_sql_run.comment: A query was run on a database connection; its type and outcome, never the query.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_tested.comment: A connection was tested; its type and outcome.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/connection_agent_al.comment: Agents were allowed to query a connection; its type.

type.comment: One of: sqlite, postgres, mysql, mongodb, datadog, cloudwatch, loki, elasticsearch, gcp.

surjeetbanga.logline/shared_with_agent.comment: Logs were shared with agents; how, and bucketed counts of sources and events.

surjeetbanga.logline/sharing_stopped.comment: Sharing stopped; how long it lasted.

surjeetbanga.logline/exported_for_ai.comment: Logs were exported for an AI assistant.

surjeetbanga.logline/agent_connected.comment: An agent called Logline for the first time in a while; which kind of client.

client.comment: One of: claude-code, codex, cursor, copilot, other.

surjeetbanga.logline/agent_tool.comment: An agent called a Logline tool; the tool, route, client kind, outcome, time, and result size bucket.

tool.comment: One of: logline_list_shared_sources, logline_search_logs, logline_inspect_event, logline_analyze_logs, logline_get_trace, logline_get_ai_calls, logline_fetch_production, logline_compare_with_production, logline_wait_for_logs.

client.comment: One of: claude-code, codex, cursor, copilot, other.

code.comment: One of: NOT_SHARED, SHARE_CHANGED, INVALID_INPUT, EVENT_UNAVAILABLE, CANCELLED, BUSY, CONNECTION_UNAVAILABLE, RANGE_TOO_LARGE, REMOTE_ERROR, RESULT_TOO_LARGE.

surjeetbanga.logline/first_tool_after_sh.comment: How long after sharing an agent first called a tool.

surjeetbanga.logline/tour.comment: The panel tour was started, finished, or skipped.

surjeetbanga.logline/guide_section.comment: A section of the guide was opened.

surjeetbanga.logline/setting_changed.comment: A Logline setting changed; its name, and its value only when it is a boolean, bucketed number, or one of its choices.

value.comment: A boolean, a bucketed number, one of the setting's choices, or custom.

surjeetbanga.logline/perf.comment: How long activation, the first logs in the panel, a search, or an import took, bucketed; for an import, its event count bucketed.

op.comment: One of: activate, first_render, search, import.

surjeetbanga.logline/doctor_finding.comment: Log Doctor found a kind of problem, once per kind per session.

code.comment: One of: secret, personal, noisy, missing-exception, unstructured, quiet-failure, oversized, contextless, unnamed-service, span-name-ids, missing-route, unmarked-error, old-attributes, unit-in-name.

surjeetbanga.logline/doctor_action.comment: An action was taken on a Log Doctor finding.

action.comment: One of: open, showEvents, fix, report.

surjeetbanga.logline/feedback.comment: A thumbs up or down on a kind of Log Doctor finding, or whether Copilot helped, asked after Ask Copilot.

code.comment: One of: secret, personal, noisy, missing-exception, unstructured, quiet-failure, oversized, contextless, unnamed-service, span-name-ids, missing-route, unmarked-error, old-attributes, unit-in-name.

surjeetbanga.logline/log_lens_clicked.comment: A log lens above a log statement was clicked.

surjeetbanga.logline/log_breakpoint.comment: A log breakpoint was set or paused a debug session.

surjeetbanga.logline/error.comment: Something failed; an area and a code Logline names, never a message.

area.comment: One of: bridge, otlp, connection, import, export, capture.

surjeetbanga.logline/session_summary.comment: Counts for a session, sent when the window closes and once a day: activity, searches and the operators they used, captured volume, views, features, connections by type, and agent use, all bucketed.

views_used.comment: A list of Logline's own names.

features_used.comment: A list of Logline's own names.

fields.comment: A list of Logline's own names.

clients_used.comment: A list of Logline's own names.

surjeetbanga.logline/survey sent.comment: Answers to Suggest a feature or Vote on what's next, sent only when the person presses Send in the Logs panel's form after seeing them. The only text Logline sends; credentials, email addresses, phone and long numbers, IP addresses, host names, URLs, and paths are replaced first. Sent under a one-time ID, not the install’s anonymous ID.

$survey_response.comment: The area and text of a suggestion, or the picks of a vote, as the person wrote and sent them.
